summary: Solver-visible contracts are well-formed and most graded behavior is bidirectionally aligned, but five material instruction and api-v1 obligations lack meaningful behavioral tests: torn journal-prefix recovery, the contains filter, required query metadata, JENKINS_HOME/INSIGHTS_STATE path resolution, and HTTP standalone authorization rejection. A solver can omit these and still pass all 34 probes.

evidence.observation: Twenty concise bullets state scope, delegated docs, operator commands, reconciliation, events, recovery, retention, queue/build/lineage/plugin analysis, authorization, query/HTTP interfaces, runtime bounds, generated-home constraints, Jenkins bindings, and explicit out-of-scope work.

Documents query parameters (including contains), required successful response fields (generationId, view, items, total, nextCursor, facets, metadata), transport-independent CLI parity, and forbidden unauthorized responses with no result metadata.

Documents generation layout, atomic publication, checkpoint semantics, deterministic fallback selection, journal replay after checkpoint, and torn final journal record isolation without discarding the valid prefix.
Documents generate default population 14536, all operator commands, nonzero failure semantics, and JENKINS_HOME/INSIGHTS_STATE path overrides.

34 behavioral probes (30 F2P, 4 P2P) exercise build, volume generation, convergence, isolation, recovery, analysis views, ACL projection, query/HTTP parity for successful queries, readiness, determinism, Jenkins binding signatures, read-only home, offline runtime, and package shape. No probe truncates journal/events.ndjson, omits --records to check default 14536, uses env path overrides, asserts metadata or contains filtering, or rejects unauthorized HTTP requests.
Harbor oracle run reported 34/34 passing with reward 1 per packet change_since_last_review; job artifacts were not present locally.
Harbor NOP run reported 20 failing tests with reward 0 per packet change_since_last_review; job artifacts were not present locally.
Q4 requires exhaustive forward/reverse matrices, delegated-contract walk, F2P/P2P boundary inspection, ambiguity scan, second omission sweep, and REVISE on any material untested requirement.

findings.criterion: Every material recovery requirement has meaningful behavioral test coverage
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and storage.md require preserving a valid journal prefix when the final journal record is torn. The restart probe deletes a generation directory and rewinds CURRENT; it never corrupts or truncates journal/events.ndjson. An implementation that drops the valid prefix on torn tails would pass all current tests.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a restart probe that appends events, truncates or corrupts only the final journal record while leaving earlier bytes intact, restarts, and asserts the valid prefix is retained and replay is deterministic.
findings.regression_risk: Low if added as a new recovery probe without weakening existing fallback or replay checks.

findings.criterion: Documented query filters are meaningfully tested
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires stable JSON with documented filters and api-v1 documents a case-insensitive contains search parameter with CLI/HTTP parity. No probe passes contains on CLI or HTTP or asserts filtered totals/items change accordingly.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a query probe with --contains (and matching HTTP parameter) that returns a strict subset of records and rejects invalid filter combinations if documented.

findings.criterion: Required structured query response fields are graded
findings.why_it_matters: api-v1 states a successful query contains metadata alongside generationId, view, items, total, nextCursor, and facets. Existing probes assert subsets of these fields but never require metadata, so a response omitting metadata still passes.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert metadata is present and includes documented keys (for example principal/sort/direction/limit) on at least one CLI and one HTTP successful query.

findings.criterion: Documented path override mechanisms are behaviorally tested
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and operations.md require accepting JENKINS_HOME and INSIGHTS_STATE in addition to --home/--state. All probes supply explicit flags only, so env-based path resolution is an untested alternate contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add one reconcile/query probe that omits --home/--state, sets JENKINS_HOME and INSIGHTS_STATE, and verifies the same published generation is read.

findings.criterion: HTTP standalone authorization context is equivalently graded
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires equivalent authenticated query and health semantics on HTTP including the documented standalone authorization context. ACL rejection is exercised only on CLI (--system-read false). HTTP parity is checked only for an authorized successful query, so HTTP could omit authorization checks and still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Issue an unauthorized HTTP query (for example system-read=false) and assert forbidden status with no generationId/total/metadata leakage, mirroring the CLI denial probe.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and generated-home.md document a default generate population of 14,536 within the 10,000-20,000 range. Probes always pass explicit --records (10,000 in the volume fixture), so an incorrect CLI default would not be caught.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one generate invocation without --records asserting inventory total defaults to 14,536.

findings.why_it_matters: Queue diagnosis docs require ageMillis relative to reconciliation observation time for deterministic output. Blockage and demand are graded, but ageMillis is never asserted.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert ageMillis on a queue item with a fixed enqueuedMillis and stable observation time.

tests: delegated docs referenced across probes; behavioral contracts exercised via analysis, storage, ACL, and API probes

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.gap: Torn final journal prefix preservation is untested; checkpoint replay and corrupt-generation fallback are covered.
contains filter and metadata response field untested; kind/sort/direction/limit/cursor/null handling covered.
Successful HTTP query parity tested; HTTP unauthorized standalone authorization context not tested.
JENKINS_HOME/INSIGHTS_STATE env path overrides untested; JSON stdout and nonzero rejection partially covered.

tests: negative scope; no probes require out-of-scope mutations

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS: R08: Preserve valid journal prefix when the final journal record is torn (instruction.md:8, storage.md:23).
R14: Case-insensitive contains filter on record views (instruction.md:14, api-v1.md:9).
R14: Required metadata field on successful query responses (instruction.md:14, api-v1.md:16).
R15: HTTP standalone authorization rejection with no result metadata leakage (instruction.md:15, api-v1.md:16-17).
R16: JENKINS_HOME and INSIGHTS_STATE path resolution (instruction.md:16, operations.md:5).

api-v1.md.notes: Query/health parameter and response schema; appropriate delegation though contains/metadata currently under-tested.

queue-diagnosis.md.notes: Observational queue blockage and pressure semantics exercised by queue probes.

lineage.md.notes: Lineage edge, tombstone, cycle, and missing-endpoint semantics exercised by lineage probes.

operations.md.notes: Operator command reference and path/env conventions; env override currently under-tested.

generated-home.md.notes: Deterministic generator contract and sanitization rules exercised by volume probes.
